notes.title: TGS2025 & Development Update🍊
notes.content: [p]Hello, this is Black Tangerine! 🍊 [/p][p]We hope you’ve been doing well. [/p][p]Today, we’d like to share an update on KILLA’s participation in TGS2025, [/p][p]as well as the latest news on its development and release.  [/p][p][/p][h1]⭐KILLA at TGS2025⭐ [/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/05ceebd9af5633a9a6b9abeadc8350f0191ce896.jpg"][/img][/p][p]Thanks to the support of [b]GYAAR Studio[/b], KILLA will be showcased at [b]TGS2025![/b] [/p][p]Be sure to visit our booth and grab some exclusive goodies📢 [/p][p][b]Booth Location: 10-E17[/b]  [/p][p]We’ve also prepared a special page—check it out! [/p][p][url="https://indie.bandainamcostudios.com/tgs2025 "]https://indie.bandainamcostudios.com/tgs2025 [/url][/p][p][/p][h1]📑 KILLA’s Development & Release [/h1][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/36c67fb0cd40e5835ab06652835ed6832bb38f2c.png"][/img][/p][p]KILLA is currently still in [b]development[/b]. [/p][p]We sincerely apologize for not being able to consistently share updates with you🥺 [/p][p]Right now, we’re working on the final ending scene—and here’s a small glimpse of Harla’s scene!  [/p][p]While the release is still some time away, we’ll keep sharing updates and news with you🙇‍♀️[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Thank you always for your support![/b][/h2]

notes.title: 🚨(Fix completed) The demo has been temporarily disabled🚨
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/e0e21a5fe98c0e21da9672643e8bf36cd9438d0a.png[/img]

We discovered a bug where the SPACE key does not work when using a Chinese keyboard,
so the demo version has been temporarily disabled.

We apologize to any players who may have come to try the game.

We will fix the issue and update the demo with a new version as soon as possible.
Again, we sincerely apologize for the inconvenience.

—
Thank you for waiting!
We've fixed the bugs that players have reported.

Please join Valhalla's journey once again. 🌕

notes.title: KILLA's New Demo Update is Here! 🌕
notes.content:
[b][h2]📢 KILLA's New Demo Update is Here! 📢[/h2][/b]
[b]‼ We have two important updates to share in this announcement! ‼[/b]

[h2][b]1. New Story Content: Valhalla and the Mentor’s Past[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/39b5bd9bdaabdb0954218fcd89f38223804b64bd.png[/img]

Thank you for waiting patiently! 😭

You can now experience Valhalla and the Mentor’s past story, which was previously omitted from past demo versions. ✨

[h2][b]2. Improved Translations[/b][/h2]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/20cb7ef7c9a54f6e9e363f0b862e1e358d1e7e8e.png[/img]

We have enhanced the quality of translations for English, Japanese, and Chinese (Simplified/Traditional). 🍀

We hope this allows us to better convey KILLA’s story to you.

The full release will feature even higher-quality translations! 😊

[h2][b]Adding KILLA to your wishlist helps us a lot! 🥺[/b][/h2]
Thank you for your continued interest!
We’ll keep working hard until the official release! 🔥
Thank you!

notes.title: The Japanese and English versions have been updated!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/61f6f9f36da7f3a97e3e5d36c6ac40431437b1a3.png[/img]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/7b90fd3921ee69d287482089455f38f5dd129c03.png[/img]


Hello. I'm Team Black Tangerine! 🍊

🎃 In celebration of the spooky Halloween Festival 🎃, KILLA has prepared a large-scale demo update!


[h2]📢 This update contains a total of three main features.[/h2]


[h3]1. Addition of [b]English and Japanese languages[/b].[/h3]
 - This is the biggest part of this update! Two new languages have been added.
 - There will undoubtedly be parts with incomplete translation. We will work on refining and fixing these parts in the next update!
 - Some scenes have not been translated yet. However, you can proceed with the story without any problems, even if you don't understand the content!


[h3]2. Addition of [b]game settings window[/b] with adjustable volume.[/h3]
 - The basics of the game! The game settings window has been added.
 - There are still a few parts that are not functioning. You can expect to see them in the next update.
 - If you find any bugs, please let us know via email or survey. We really appreciate it.


[h3]3. Addition of the "Dream of Vallhalla" [b]story[/b].[/h3]
A new story has been added!
 - Part of the second fantasy deduction system "Dream" following the resonance has been revealed.
 - If you find any bugs, please let us know via email or survey. We really appreciate it.
 - At the end of the demo, there is a survey where you can leave short feedback!


If you participate, we will reward you with an even better KILLA.
(Your feedback could be the goal of the next update! It's for real! (۶•̀ᴗ•́)۶)


[h3]👻 Happy Halloween to everyone! 👻[/h3]

Thank you!
Team Team Black Tangerine.

notes.title: The KILLA demo version has been released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/99f912acc8f0a176bb3fb4d7dc6701546dca7673.png[/img]

Hello, we are [b]Team Black Tangerine[/b], the developers of KILLA.




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/8778f0c0b8b385195d8b555380aaf31443703bca.png[/img]

[h2]First Announcement: KILLA Participates in BIC[/h2]

KILLA has been selected for the rookie section at this year's Busan Indie Connect (a.k.a. BIC). 
It was our first exhibition, and though we had many shortcomings.
BUT it was a very enjoyable experience!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/47166eeff031abc5f018475d94e101d1c536e72f.png[/img]

We are truly grateful to have been selected as finalists in the Story category.




[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/5e2ee182eaa1e587286fb17cbfdce9d2d5b64552.gif[/img]

[h2]Second Announcement: KILLA Demo Version Release[/h2]

The KILLA demo is set to be released on September 22nd at 21:00 KST. 


We will be uploading the exhibition build shown at BIC to Steam, 
and we plan to continue updating it. 


We kindly ask for your interest and feedback.

.
.
.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44515249/9d35d1252b21f4776eb66966ffd5515fda053e4d.gif[/img]

Thank you for your interest in KILLA! 
We will repay your support with a more developed game. 


We will continue to update and share development updates on Steam, so please stay tuned.


With love,
Team Black Tangerine
